6b96b8426627aa6fbc77329b4aa82369cfe9d74e: Bivio is a low-key resort, modest in scale: 27 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Bivio's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2560 m and a village at 1769 m, Bivio's snow cover is generally reliable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause tension early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly once the first serious snowfalls arrive. The day lift pass at 50€ places Bivio among the mid-range resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and facilities justifies this price for most skiers. 6b98651989c8b301779f102e7990ac0ca4e716a5: A resort on a human scale, Glacier de Hintertux focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 64 km of runs are perfect for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly find new terrain. Glacier de Hintertux has managed to keep the identity of an authentic mountain village, far from the concrete resorts of the 1970s. People come here for the clean air, the unspoilt scenery and a friendly atmosphere that stands in contrast to the industrialisation of skiing in some large ski areas. When it comes to snow, Glacier de Hintertux is in a strong position with its summit at 3250 m: even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well until April. The village at 1500 m is also well placed to ensure comfortable conditions from as early as mid-December. Budget for a stay at Glacier de Hintertux is clearly high: 82€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. That is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: Glacier de Hintertux delivers on its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most types of skier without disappointing.
